closedFindings: Broker now uses root-owned existing local /usr/bin/node; cloud-only binary path removed.
Cgroup parser handles exact direct and default template slice paths while rejecting foreign contexts.
Human confirmation has absolute60s deadline, polkit90s and service180s; previous5s confirmation defect corrected.
Local pkcheck --help confirms --details option used by current broker.
reviewedProperties: SO_PEERCRED UID/GID and process starttime are checked before and after action-specific OS authentication. UID alone cannot approve.
Proposal signature and independent root pins bind exact action, grant/version/hash, release/hash, nonce, expiry and workspace device/inode; signer revalidates.
Credential loading is fixed to actual approval service read-only systemd mount and enrolled Human public key; no arbitrary key path.
Separate Human key and existing independent enrollment required; no identity generation or auto enrollment.
Root journal intent is exclusive and durable before signature; ambiguous outcome retained.
Window receives APPROVED_NOT_APPLIED status only; no mutation consumer or service activation invoked.
unclosedProductionGates: Actual independently trusted Human enrollment and matching encrypted key are not established by these tests.
Full signed release and fixed launcher admission must cover all Human source/dependencies before installation.
Effective installed polkit rules must be audited to exclude silent allow overrides; real user presence/authentication still untested.
Grant/trust/enrollment change approval artifacts have no mutation consumer and must not be described as applied authority.
